title: MiniQMT managed order preflight incorrectly rejects legal STAR-market buy quantities
description:
Expected: AIstock MiniQMT managed-order preflight must use the same stock-aware board-lot rule as the order builder and execution algorithms. For STAR-market symbols 688xxx/689xxx, BUY quantity must be at least 200 shares and may then increase by 1 share. A legal order such as 688379.SH quantity 2706 must pass AIstock preflight and be submitted to miniQMT SIM/LIVE subject to broker/account checks.
Actual: backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger/order_service.py still applies a hard-coded BUY quantity check request.quantity % 100 != 0 for every symbol. This contradicts backend/execution_algos/board_lot.py and backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger/selection_order_builder.py, which already use stock-aware board_lot_rule()/round_to_board_lot(). During the 2026-05-19 miniQMT SIM POC, StrategyPackage output generated legal STAR-market quantities, but AIstock preflight rejected them with BUY_BOARD_LOT before broker submission. This caused the automated two-strategy runner to fail after backend restart and forced an emergency manual workaround for strategy A; strategy B submission was paused to avoid expanding the workaround.
reproduce_command: git blame -L 190,210 -- backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger/order_service.py && rg -n "BUY_BOARD_LOT|request\.quantity % 100|board_lot_rule|round_to_board_lot" backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger backend/execution_algos/board_lot.py backend/tests/qmt_strategy_ledger -S

events.note: Root cause introduction: git blame shows the hard-coded BUY_BOARD_LOT check was introduced by commit d15376dd (2026-05-18 23:31:58 +0800), commit message "feat(qmt): add miniqmt multi-strategy ledger workflow". This is not an old legacy file from months ago; it was introduced with the new qmt_strategy_ledger managed-order workflow.

Why orders pass multiple checks: there are separate layers by design: SelectionOrderBuilder converts StrategyPackage/Selection candidates into managed order requests; QmtManagedOrderService.preview_order performs AIstock local account/risk/idempotency preflight before broker call; broker submit then lets miniQMT/xtquant enforce broker/exchange/account rules. The layering is reasonable for safety, but it is only safe if all layers depend on one canonical rule source.

Why no unified rule: order_service.py duplicated a simplified 100-share A-share rule instead of reusing backend.execution_algos.board_lot.board_lot_rule or round_to_board_lot. This created a rule split: builder accepts legal STAR quantities while preflight rejects them.

Observed evidence on 2026-05-19: preopen runner log contains runner_failed with BUY_BOARD_LOT for qmtbind_2d87c917ec2f4e23a8fa822fee544156 after successful QMT SIM connection and selection artifact generation. Example candidate 688379.SH had reference_price 73.89, target_weight 0.02, and legal STAR quantity 2706, but AIstock preflight requires 100-share multiple.

Business impact: P0 because it blocks or distorts real miniQMT multi-strategy SIM/LIVE execution and can lead operators to submit altered quantities that differ from strategy/package sizing. It also contradicts the platform fail-fast/no-fake-success trading rule and affects trading execution correctness.

Fix expectation: remove hard-coded request.quantity % 100 check from order_service.py and validate BUY/SELL quantities using the canonical board-lot helper. Add regression tests proving 688/689 BUY quantity 201/2706 passes, 688 BUY 199 fails, 300/600/00 non-100 BUY fails, and SelectionOrderBuilder plus QmtManagedOrderService use identical rules.

Operational note: Strategy A was emergency-submitted after 100-share downward normalization to start SIM validation; strategy B was paused until this P0 is fixed or explicitly overridden. Future remediation must reconcile/record the emergency workaround in validation evidence.
Mirrored BUG-048 to GitHub issue #46 via gh CLI because MCP live sync lacked GITHUB_REPOSITORY in this session.
